name: application-form-field-wizard
title: Form Field Wizard
description: A reviewable, jump-anywhere section list for long official forms, with overall progress, per-section completion status, and a save-and-continue-later affordance.
useWhen: Long official or government-style applications (permits, benefits, licenses) split into multiple sections, where users often need to save and return later.
Users benefit from jumping directly to any section rather than being forced through a strict linear step order.
avoidWhen: The flow must be completed strictly in order without jumping ahead — `Stepper Wizard`'s linear step header enforces that better.
The form is short enough to fit on one screen — a section list adds unnecessary structure for a handful of fields.
responsiveBehavior: The section list and header stack in a single column at all widths; the progress bar and section rows keep their full width at any container size.
accessibility: Each section is a real <button> in an ordered <ul>, keyboard-reachable and operable without a pointer, enabling non-linear navigation.
The current section carries aria-current="true" in addition to its ring highlight, and each row's status (Complete, Editing, Not started) is stated as visible text, not color alone.
Completed sections show a checkmark icon alongside the 'Complete' text label, reinforcing status beyond color.

variants.title: Passport application
variants.description: A five-section passport application (DS-11) with an overall '3 of 5 complete' progress bar, two completed sections, the current section highlighted, and two not-started sections, plus 'Save & continue later' and 'Continue editing' actions.
accessibility: The current section carries aria-current="true"; each status is stated as text.

variants.title: Passport application (Dark)
variants.description: Form field wizard adapted for dark surfaces, including the progress bar fill and current-section highlight.
accessibility: Section text, status labels, and the progress bar all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background.
